scientific_question: Does an unusually derivatives-dominant BTC turnover day predict a larger next-UTC-day BTC spot realized range after controlling for current-day range clustering?
economic_mechanism: A higher USD-M futures-to-spot turnover ratio is treated as a derivatives/leverage/speculation intensity state variable. The prospective directional claim is volatility expansion, not bullish or bearish price direction.

source_authority.archive_provenance_rule: Every Discovery archive must pass the current official .CHECKSUM and its ZIP SHA-256 must exactly equal the already-frozen source-gate archive_manifest SHA-256 for the same venue/month.

predictor.threshold_rule: Sort the immediately previous 180 completed log-ratio values ascending; threshold is the 144th order statistic (1-indexed), i.e. sorted_previous_180[143]. Current day t is excluded from threshold formation.
predictor.warmup_rule: No event classification before 180 completed prior UTC days exist.
predictor.signal_availability: Only after UTC day t is fully complete.

bootstrap.method: moving contiguous block bootstrap over the eligible chronological day sequence

post_result_rule: STOP after Discovery classification. A surviving mechanism does not authorize a trading strategy, transaction-cost backtest, 2025/2026 access, or threshold/horizon tuning. Any executable volatility strategy must be a separately named MVE with a new prospective freeze and untouched validation data.
prohibited_rescues: No funding/OI/taker/indicator filter addition after outcomes
No transaction-cost or PnL interpretation in this mechanism MVE
